_source: Star Citizen Game Files (TheCollector contract generator)

trades.title: Asgard Fight Mod
trades.description: Wikelo mod Asgard and so that it fights more. You in a fight, this mod is what you want. Plus, good deal on the trade. Just bring items here and I give you the ship.

trades.title: ATLS Cool Metal Color
trades.description: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.

trades.title: ATLS Orange Line
trades.description: Many Human work place have orange color there. Must mean work to you. This suit does work. Make sense.

trades.title: ATLS Snowland Color
trades.description: Wikelo travel to one Human planet and find very cold, but very pretty. This remind of that.

trades.title: Build a Mod Scorpius
trades.description: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.

trades.title: Clipper Fight Now
trades.description: Clipper does a bunch of things good, but Wikelo think what if it did more fight? Then it still do all things, but now do one thing better. Good yes? I give you blueprint, you make my new metamaterial, bring to me, and I will trade.

trades.title: Extra Special Wolf
trades.description: Wikelo very excited. Have idea for new material. But making it is most tricky. Very complicated. Need help fabricating a test sample. I give you blueprint, you make, bring to me, and I will trade. Give you extra special L-22 Wolf. Very powerful, very wolf.

rewards.name: Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Special

trades.title: F8 War Mod
trades.description: Can make you custom of F8 that take good fighting ship and make a better fighting ship. Bring things and I will make. Bye.

rewards.name: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Firebird Mod
trades.description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.

rewards.name: Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Fortune ship for you
trades.description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

trades.title: Golem Rocks
trades.description:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do.

Bring.

I make.

trades.title: Guardian Fight Mod
trades.description: This ship look like insect in the Protectorate. Fun look. Painful sting. Wikelo can make custom version for you if you want. Make enemies sting. Bye.

trades.title: Guardian take down ship
trades.description: Insect ship again. This one help take down other ship but if you want it to take down better. Can make. See list and tell Wikelo. Bye.

trades.title: Guardian WiK-X
trades.description:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.

rewards.name: Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Make a Ursa Mod
trades.description: Wikelo branching into ships too. Took a look at Ursa and improved. Bring parts for me and I will make for you. Explore planet better. Go do.

trades.title: Make ATLS shoot
trades.description:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.'

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.

trades.title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
trades.description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to the Emporium. Will make.

Wikelo

trades.title: More than a Max
trades.description: If you want to move many things. Hercules ship, very good for that. Wikelo even know souli back in Protectorate that started to use. Very big. Wikelo can give you similar version if you get what Wikelo need. Look at list and tell me.

rewards.name: MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special

trades.title: Most Special Wolf
trades.description: You have been good trade partner for Wikelo. Offer you this very special Wolf mod. Make trade even better - Bring me what I want and I give you the special Wolf AND Antium Armor AND a VOLT LMG. Very good deal for my very good customer.

rewards.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo War Special

trades.title: New Move Big Starlancer Ship
trades.description: If you like big space to move things, Wikelo can do useful and wonder things to MISC ship for you. Bring me pieces and I will give you version even better than what Xi'an can do.

rewards.name: MISC Starlancer TAC Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Now make Polaris. Short Time Deal.
trades.description:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship.

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bring to the Emporium if want.

Bye.

trades.title: Noxy Mod
trades.description: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.

trades.title: Peregrine Wikelo Mod
trades.description: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.

rewards.name: Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Special

trades.title: Prospects Look Good
trades.description: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.

trades.title: Prowler More Utility
trades.description: Wikelo work hard. You work hard. Prowler Utility work hard. But you bring me right items, I make it work more hard, then you work less hard. Bye.

rewards.name: Esperia Prowler Utility Wikelo Work Special

trades.title: Pulse Plus
trades.description: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.

trades.title: Ready for RAFT?
trades.description: RAFT is very useful. Wikelo take it and make it very very useful. Do work and make you happy. You want? Bring items to Wikelo for trade.

trades.title: Red Fight Apollo
trades.description: Apollo very good ship. Would be much better if ship was red. Wikelo make all things possible. You trade for what I want and we have a deal.

rewards.name: RSI Apollo Triage Wikelo Sneak Special

trades.title: RSI Meteor Mod
trades.description:
Meteor big. It heavy. Have many guns. But Wikelo figure out way to make even better. You have things I will take to do.

That is all.

trades.title: Sneaky Stabber
trades.description: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.

rewards.name: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special

trades.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
trades.description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

rewards.name: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sneak Special

trades.title: Special Idris For Killing
trades.description: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.

trades.title: Spirit Cargo mod
trades.description: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

trades.title: Starfighter Inferno Special
trades.description: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.

rewards.name: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Starlifter A2 War Mod
trades.description: Bring Wikelo the things and I make you A2 Starlifter that fights better. Does war so good make you call it A1! Bye.

rewards.name: Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo War Special

trades.title: Upgrade Intrepid
trades.description: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.

trades.title: Want Taurus ship
trades.description: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.

rewards.name: RSI Constellation Taurus Wikelo War Special

trades.title: What is Terrapin?
trades.description:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.

rewards.name: Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Special

trades.title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf
trades.description: If you want to be quiet and surprise people, this is the Wolf you want. Wikelo mod it to be extra stealth. Trade you for it when you bring me the items I want.

rewards.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special

trades.title: Wikelo Navy F7
trades.description: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.

trades.title: Zeus Cargo Special
trades.description: Wikelo can make new version of cargo Zeus ship. If you want, bring what needed, then you can have ship. Fair. Bye.

trades.title: Zeus Special
trades.description: Wikelo can make new version of Zeus ship. I know it important ship to Human. Not sure why, but yes, very useful ship. Anyway, can upgrade and make a little prettier. What I need listed, if you want, bring. Bye.

rewards.name: RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special

trades.title: Armor with horn and string
trades.description:
Hello, know many humans want saldynium for regen problem. Credits good, yes, but Wikelo can use that, kopion horn, and other things to make special armor.

Once done, you be very tough. Very scary.

You see items needed. Bring to the Emporium and I make for you.

Bye.

trades.title: Armor with Vanduul
trades.description:
Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.

trades.title: Curious Weapon
trades.description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

trades.title: Do Lava Suit
trades.description: If you have armor, Wikelo can make it look warm. Good look for useful armor. Bring me things and will do.

trades.title: Fun Kopion Skull Gun
trades.description:
Hello. Can make fun change to gun if you want. Use kopion skin for pattern and little skull dangle. Very effective. Shoot much better.

All you need is bring me parts to the Emporium and will make.

Bye.

rewards.name: Parallax "Fun Kopion Skull" Energy Assault Rifle

trades.title: Fun Military Skull Gun
trades.description:
Hello. Can do version of gun if you kopion soldier. Make material like soldier camouflage but with dead skull on front. Gun shoot better too.

If want, bring part to the Emporium and will make.

rewards.name: Parallax "Fun Military Skull" Energy Assault Rifle

trades.title: Heavy and Bright
trades.description: This armor is big, yes! Protect you real good. Wikelo make it extra bright so everyone can see how good your armor is. If you bring the things I need, I trade for it.

trades.title: Hide Snow Suit
trades.description:
You want be hidden. Wikelo understand. Not ask questions why. But what do when you in snow? Wikelo have suit for that.

Welcome.

trades.title: Hot Shot
trades.description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

trades.title: Make glowy armor
trades.description:
Wikelo had exciting idea during brief work rest. Was thinking about the little glow worms in Pyro and saw armor get changed to look like.

If you get me parts, bring to the Emporium and will make for you then you can glow too.

Bye.

trades.title: Make VOLT shotgun angrier
trades.description:
You feel like gun not angry enough? VOLT shotgun very powerful, very dangerous, but not scary? Bring to me. Can make very scary and angry.

They respect you then. Bring to the Emporium and we make.

Bye.

trades.title: Red Fight Armor
trades.description: Wikelo hear that Humans think red is the color of passion and anger. This armor good for both. You give me items on list and this red armor is yours.

trades.title: Red Fight Shotgun
trades.description: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.

trades.title: Shiny Builder Suit
trades.description: You need utility suit. Good for work. If you like, Wikelo can make shinier. Look real good. See what Wikelo need and bring.

trades.title: Snow Snipe
trades.description:
Want to shoot long away and stay hiding. But it snowing? Wikelo have gun for you.

Bring things. I give.

Bye.

rewards.name: Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Cap)

trades.title: Suit Up Take Off
trades.description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

trades.title: Test Armor
trades.description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.

trades.title: Too Much Gun
trades.description: This gun is very big and very loud. Wikelo love it. Made it extra bright so that everyone can see how special this gun is. I think you will like this so bring me trade.

trades.title: Yormandi Gun
trades.description: This gun has picture of amazing creature on side. Use it and it make you big and strong like Yormandi. Spit lightning. Bring my items and then you get it. Bye.

trades.title: Your Best Shot
trades.description: This rifle is very good at shooting, but could have nicer design. Wikelo fix. Looks very nice now. Give to you for trade. Bring me things, I give you rifle. Even give you blueprint if you need.

trades.title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
trades.description:
If you want other way to get favors from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for scrip given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to the Emporium, will trade for favor.

Bye.

trades.title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
trades.description:
Wikelo has another way to get favors if you interested.

Your Mercenary souli has scrip metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to the Emporium, will trade for favor.

Bye.

trades.title: Trade Worm Parts for Favors?
trades.description:
Have new way to get favors from Wikelo. Hear much about worm things in radiation storms. Made up of many interesting parts that Wikelo find use for.

If you bring parts to the Emporium, will trade for favor.

Bye.

trades.title: Turn Things to Favor
trades.description:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out favors, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to the Emporium and will trade for favor.

Bye.

trades.title: Want Polaris? Need something special.
trades.description:
Wikelo need large amounts of quantainium and is willing to give you nice Polaris in exchange but also know many humans not have much space, so you trade as you go. Wikelo will you Polaris bits if you want trade quantainium. Work like favors. Help Wikelo remember how much you give.

Bring quantainium to the Emporium and will trade for bits.

Bye.

trades.title: Wikelo Arrive to System
trades.description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at the Emporium.

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

trades.title: Very Hungry
trades.description:
You humans keep Wikelo very busy. Work more than when I at old souli. But Wikelo very hungry now and can't get food.

Please help. Bring food and drink to Wikelo Emporium at the Emporium.

Very appreciate your help. Will give thing in return.

Bye.

costs.name: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream
